== Status ==
There is no postmarketOS port yet. Checked on 2026-10-14 against pmaports (<code>main</code>): no <code>device-motorola-ibiza</code> in
<code>main</code>, <code>community</code>, <code>testing</code> or <code>archived</code>, and no merge request or issue mentioning ibiza, SM4350 or Moto G50.
The only Motorola device in <code>testing</code> is the Edge 30 (<code>motorola-dubai</code>, SM7325, mainline kernel, fastboot, boot image header v2);
the other Motorola packages are archived, mostly old downstream-kernel ports. A merge request for the Moto G82 5G
(<code>motorola-rhodep</code>, SM6375, mainline 7.2-rc5 with WCN3990 WiFi/Bluetooth working) was opened in August 2026 and closed on 2026-09-30 (reason not visible without login).
These notes come from getting Debian 13 (arm64, systemd) running on the stock bootloader with the vendor 5.4 kernel, and are
meant to be the groundwork for a pmaports device package.

== What works (vendor 5.4 kernel, Debian userspace) ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Feature !! State !! Notes
|-
| Booting || Works || <code>fastboot boot</code> of an Android boot image v3 (kernel + own initramfs) with the stock <code>vendor_boot</code>; flashing it to <code>boot_a</code> also works
|-
| USB gadget || Works || configfs: NCM + ACM
|-
| WiFi || Works || Needs the modem: firmware runs in a modem protection domain. Needs <code>qrtr</code>, <code>pd-mapper</code>, <code>tqftpserv</code>, <code>rmtfs</code> started before the modem, plus Android's <code>pm-service</code> and <code>cnss-daemon</code> (see below)
|-
| Bluetooth || Partly || Scan works. Pairing and audio: TODO. Firmware loaded from userspace, see below
|-
| Battery / charging / thermal sensors || Works || sysfs (<code>qcom_battery</code>, thermal zones)
|-
| cpufreq || Works || schedutil on both clusters
|-
| Display, touch, GPU, audio, camera, modem (cellular) || TODO || not attempted
|}

== Things a port has to know ==
* The kernel has no <code>CONFIG_DEVTMPFS</code>, no IPC/PID/USER namespaces, no debugfs, no FHANDLE/AUTOFS. systemd treats a non-mount-point <code>/dev</code> as fatal, so the initramfs mounts a tmpfs on the new root's <code>/dev</code> and fills it from <code>/sys/class/*</code> before <code>switch_root</code>. Units that use namespaces need <code>PrivateIPC=no</code> etc.
* The ramdisk must be LZ4 (legacy) for this bootloader; gzip stacked after LZ4 fails to boot.
* WiFi firmware lives in the modem. The downstream kernel drops userspace QRTR registrations made after the modem link comes up, so the QRTR services must be running first. Run <code>rmtfs</code> on copies of <code>modemst1/modemst2/fsg/fsc</code>, never the real partitions (they hold IMEI and RF calibration).
* <code>cnss-daemon</code> and <code>pm-service</code> are bionic binaries; they run from the read-only <code>system</code>/<code>vendor</code> partitions in a chroot with a small <code>LD_PRELOAD</code> that fakes the property service and SELinux calls. The board data <code>bdwlan_ibiza_ipa.bin</code> must be visible at <code>/vendor/firmware_mnt/image</code>.
* <code>wlan.ko</code> is built with <code>PANIC_ON_BUG</code>: never <code>rmmod wlan</code> after a failed load.
* Bluetooth: the host UART runtime-suspends when idle and closing the tty drops RTS; the kernel's <code>hci_qca</code> first TLV segment of 243 bytes kills the chip's parser (16 bytes works). Keep the tty open from a resident process and <code>btattach</code> to a pty.
* '''Never resize or add entries to the GPT of the UFS LUN holding <code>super</code>/<code>userdata</code> with sgdisk.''' The bootloader then reads none of that LUN (no <code>cid</code>/<code>imei</code>, <code>fastboot boot</code> fails with "No Media"). Recovery: <code>fastboot flash partition gpt.bin</code> from the stock firmware package.
* A/B: with no Android to call <code>markBootSuccessful</code>, the slot's retry counter decrements every boot; set the successful bit (bit 54 of the <code>boot_a</code> GPT attributes, rewriting both tables and CRCs) or reset with <code>fastboot set_active a</code>. <code>fastboot flash boot_a</code> resets the attributes.

== Installation sketch ==
# Unlock the bootloader (Motorola unlock code).
# Back up <code>boot_a</code>, <code>modem*</code>, <code>modemst1/2</code>, <code>fsg</code>, <code>fsc</code>, <code>persist</code> and the GPT.
# Test with <code>fastboot boot boot.img</code> (nothing is written; a reboot returns to the previous system).
